summary: Tested new CATEGORY BADGES feature (backend endpoint + CategoryBadgesModal + profile integration). All backend and frontend checks pass. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases (shape, spec names, anonymous all-zero, 404). Frontend: profile badge is Pressable with 'VEDI TUTTE LE SPILLE' hint, modal opens with 9 sections × 3 tiers, spec names (politica/gossip/tech) match, locked tiers show '0/100' progress with reduced opacity, close returns to profile, and on user B public profile the fallback CTA `public-badges-view-all` correctly opens the same modal (badge not unlocked for user B).
critical_code_review_comments: AUTH_EMAIL_ENABLED=false in /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx hides the email tab from UI. Testing therefore had to inject the auth token via localStorage. If email login is a real product requirement it should be re-enabled.

CategoryBadgesModal.tsx: total tier count is displayed as 27 (9x3) but individual `unlockedCount` currently doesn't include a tier-4/master concept — fine for current scope, just noting for future extensions.
server.py has grown large (>2000 lines seen). Consider splitting into modules (auth/, feuds/, badges/, moderation/) for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend web preview does not expose the EMAIL auth tab (AUTH_EMAIL_ENABLED=false). To test as a logged-in email user, POST /api/auth/login via curl then inject the token: `localStorage.setItem('faide_token', JSON.stringify(token))` before navigating. Category badges modal testIDs: category-badges-modal, category-badges-close, badges-section-{cat}, badge-{cat}-tier{1|2|3}. Public profile fallback CTA testID: public-badges-view-all.
